title: 伸びてる発信者を3人見つけて参考にする
content:
伸びてる発信者を3人見つけて参考にする  
参考動画の画面をスクショして素材化する  
スクショをClaudeに渡してSeedance用の生成プロンプトを作らせる

en.content:
Find three trending content creators to use as references  
Take screenshots of the reference videos and use them as materials  
Give the screenshots to Claude to create a Seedance generation prompt  
Generate background videos with Seedance  
Overlay the transcribed script (subtitles/captions) onto the video  
Prioritize removing any AI feel in the final product  
Reuse the video materials to mass-produce short videos

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] ① Find three trending content creators  
② Take screenshots of the videos  
③ Send the screenshots to Claude to create a prompt  
④ Generate background videos with Seedance  
⑤ Overlay the transcribed script onto the video

After that, it's just a matter of mass production.

The key point is,

[Thread 2] to eliminate any AI feel.

In other words,  
if you can do that, you hardly need any video editing skills.

Moreover, since the video materials you create can be reused multiple times, they are very compatible with short videos.

If you're curious about the specific method,  
check out the free section below↓

[Thread 3] https://t.co/myo64qpKFm
